source.label: MOCK ultra-rare NCL subtype X (fictional)
source.summary: A FICTIONAL, made-up ultra-rare Batten-like disease used to demo the 'no known group' case. Not a real diagnosis.

target.label: Neuronal ceroid lipofuscinosis
target.summary: A group of inherited brain diseases (often called Batten disease) in which waste material builds up inside cells' recycling centres, the lysosomes.

supporting.quote: [MOCK] Evidence that MOCK ultra-rare NCL subtype X (fictional) is a form of Neuronal ceroid lipofuscinosis.
